[[Thorgall's Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Thorgall Bludgeonhammer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]]) 
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]]) 
:Reduces [[Weakness]] duration on you by 20% 

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Tall Shield]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Sheltered by Faith" and "Only the Strong Survive".
